newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Jindo wins $200 mln container orders.
newsitem.headline: Jindo wins $200 mln container orders.

text.p: South Korea's Jindo Corp won $200 million (178.4 billion won) in container orders from Britain, Denmark, Japan and the United States in the second half of April, Jindo officials said on Friday.

A company spokesman said the company won orders for 100,000 TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent units) of steel containers and 1,500 units of refrigerated containers from P&O Nedlloyd B.V., Maersk Line, Nippon Yusen Kaisha, Transamerica Leasing Inc and Genstar Container Corp.
The orders would be produced by the company's China plants and would be delivered by the end of the first quarter of 1998, the spokesman said.
Last year, Jindo's turnover in its container business totalled 490 billion won, up eight percent from 449.7 billion won in 1995.
The spokesman said the company has joint venture container plants in Guangzhou, Dalian, Shanghai, Quingdao and Guangjin, China.

The company's Guangzhou Jindo Container Co Ltd, established in 1992, has an annual production capacity of 54,000 TEUs of steel containers and the Dalian Jindo Container Co Ltd, established in 1993, has an annual production capacity of 54,000 TEUs of steel containers.

The Shanghai Jindo Container Co Ltd, established in 1995, also has an annual production capacity of 54,000 TEUs of steel containers and the Quingdao Jindo Container Co Ltd, established in 1996, has an annual production capacity of 24,000 TEUs of reefer containers.

The spokesman said it also has Guangjin Casting and Forging Foundry Co Ltd with an annual production capacity of 140,000 sets (container components) and Shanghai Jindo Container Refurbishing and Repairing Co Ltd in China.
